title: Utility Meter Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:meter
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often utility meter events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on utility meter events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your utility meter exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
